candidates.reason: Dedicated test module for scrapy.core.downloader.handlers.http2.H2DownloadHandler: it imports the handler class, configures it through the DOWNLOAD_HANDLERS string path, and asserts on the scrapy.core.http2.stream logger. Every half of the change (dropping the experimental marking and privatizing the handler/module API) lands on this file.

Tests the supporting scrapy.core.http2.protocol and scrapy.core.http2.stream modules through direct imports, mock.patch targets, and caplog logger names. If the HTTP/2 client package is privatized (module path rename), this file must be updated even though it never touches the download handler class.

Shared test bases that the twisted HTTP/2 test class composes; they instantiate the handler through download_handler_cls/settings_dict and encode handler-specific HTTP/2 expectations. A change to the handler class name, module path, or supported-behavior flags can require updating these bases.
